&#0a20d4GS: ALSO GATES. QUICK TUTORIAL. YOUR FIRST GATE TAKES YOU SOMEWHERE ELSE ON YOUR PLANET. NEW AREA, NEW CONTENT, YOU KNOW HOW IT IS.
&#0a20d4GS: THE SECOND ONE GOES STRAIGHT TO §aYOUR SERVER PLAYER'S HOUSE&#0a20d4. GREAT FOR COLLABS.
&#0a20d4GS: AND IF YOU WANNA GO HOME, LOOK FOR A RETURN NODE. THEY'RE ALL OVER YOUR PLANET. JUMP IN AND BOOM, BACK AT BASE.
